proposals.before: On the day Establishing Spring, they welcomed spring at the eastern suburb and sacrificed to the Green Thearch Gou Mang.
proposals.after: On the day Establishing Spring, they welcomed spring at the eastern suburb and sacrificed to the Green Thearch and Gou Mang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 青帝句芒 names two cult recipients (Green Thearch and Gou Mang); the literal fuses them into one name.

proposals.before: On the day Establishing Summer, they welcomed summer at the southern suburb and sacrificed to the Red Thearch Zhu Rong.
proposals.after: On the day Establishing Summer, they welcomed summer at the southern suburb and sacrificed to the Red Thearch and Zhu Rong.
proposals.reason: Chinese 赤帝祝融 names two cult recipients; the literal fuses them into one name.

proposals.before: On the day Establishing Autumn, they welcomed autumn at the western suburb and sacrificed to the White Thearch Ru Shou.
proposals.after: On the day Establishing Autumn, they welcomed autumn at the western suburb and sacrificed to the White Thearch and Ru Shou.
proposals.reason: Chinese 白帝蓐收 names two cult recipients; the literal fuses them into one name.

proposals.before: On the day Establishing Winter, they welcomed winter at the northern suburb and sacrificed to the Black Thearch Xuan Ming.
proposals.after: On the day Establishing Winter, they welcomed winter at the northern suburb and sacrificed to the Black Thearch and Xuan Ming.
proposals.reason: Chinese 黑帝玄冥 names two cult recipients; the literal fuses them into one name.

proposals.before: When the ceremonies ended, he presented himself to the empress and gave a banquet for the kings, marquises, and officials.
proposals.after: When the ceremonies ended, he then gave audience to the eastern lords and gave a banquet for the kings, marquises, and officials.
proposals.reason: 东后 in the fengshan/tour idiom means the eastern regional lords, not an empress; the idiomatic rendering invents an empress audience.

proposals.before: When the affair was finished, then they had audience with the Eastern Empress and feasted and bestowed on kings, marquises, and the host of ministers.
proposals.after: When the affair was finished, then he had audience with the eastern lords and feasted and bestowed on kings, marquises, and the host of ministers.
proposals.reason: 东后 means eastern lords/princes, not Eastern Empress.

decisions.reason: 祭青帝句芒 names two suburban cult recipients, the Green Thearch and Gou Mang; the fused literal name is wrong, and inserting and matches the paired seasonal cult pattern.
祭赤帝祝融 likewise names the Red Thearch and Zhu Rong as two recipients; the original literal wrongly merges them into one name.
祭白帝蓐收 names the White Thearch and Ru Shou as two cult recipients; the and-separated rendering corrects the fused literal.
祭黑帝玄冥 names the Black Thearch and Xuan Ming as two recipients; separating them restores the parallel five-suburb cult formula.

decisions.after: When the ceremonies ended, he received the eastern lords in audience, then feasted and rewarded the kings, marquises, and ministers.
decisions.reason: 東后 means the eastern feudal lords here; the emperor receives them in audience and then rewards the assembled nobles and ministers.

decisions.after: When the rites were complete, he received the eastern lords in audience and held a banquet and bestowed gifts on the kings, marquises, and assembled ministers.
decisions.reason: 東后 means the eastern lords, not an Eastern Empress, and the emperor is the one receiving them in audience.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遂觐东后，飨赐王侯群臣
